messages.content: Please check the weather in Tokyo and convert 22°C to Fahrenheit. Then book flight CA1234 for Alex Chen in economy. After that, scan my living_room devices and select the smart lock, check the status of the bedroom AC with device_id ac_bedroom, and if needed, prepare it and restart it. Also turn on the living room light with device ID light_living to 35% brightness. Finally, create a high-priority app note for user u_alex titled “Travel readiness and home device prep” with the content “Flight booked successfully” and the tags travel, iot, and predeparture.
